messages:
maria (PM): quick thread — need to close scope for Dedicated burst behavior for next quarter. main asks: soft-preempt model, per-tenant burst credits, and billing rules.

ajay (Eng): +1. we should be explicit about what "soft-preempt" means: evict low-priority KV caches and background warmers first, not active inference connections.

lucy (SRE): agree. also need a graceful signal path so clients can degrade to cheaper model variants. we can't hard-kill active requests.

thomas (Data): from telemetry, ~12% of customers produce 60% of burst spikes. credits could be sized by historical 95th percentile burst minutes.

maria (PM): proposal draft: 1) each tenant gets monthly burst credits (minutes of elevated qps) proportioned to commit tier; 2) soft-preempt policy reduces best-effort workers and lowers max concurrent background streams; 3) automatic fallback to pinned lighter model if latency/SLO is threatened.

ajay (Eng): sounds OK. one implementation detail: need a token bucket per-tenant + global reserve for emergency bursts. token refill rule = commit_tier_multiplier * base_rate. sample config:```
tenant_burst: {
  bucket_capacity: 600,
  refill_per_min: 30,
  emergency_reserve: 120
}
```

lucy (SRE): + the runtime must emit metrics: `tenant.burst.tokens`, `tenant.preempt.count`, `tenant.fallbacks` and an event when emergency_reserve is touched. those map to alerts/backstop.

maria (PM): acceptance criteria for beta: - can enforce per-tenant token bucket, - fallback to compatible smaller model variant < 200ms extra latency for 95% of requests, - alert when emergency_reserve used.

thomas (Data): how do we bill overflow? options: 1) flat overage per minute, 2) pro-rated credit consumption at higher per-minute rate, 3) auto-upgrade to higher reserved lane. customers prefer predictable.

ajay (Eng): prefer pro-rated consumption so we can throttle without service disruption. billing formula sketch: `bill_minutes = overflow_minutes * surcharge_rate`; surcharge_rate = 2x for small, 1.5x for committed enterprise.

maria (PM): need legal + finance signoff on surcharge tiers. ops-bot: "ticket created: PRD-874 - Dedicated Burst billing tiers" :memo:  

lucy (SRE): risk note: soft-preempt adds complexity to autoscaler decisions. we need a sim-run before rollout. propose a canary for 5% of tenants with synthetic traffic for 48h.

maria (PM): launch checklist (beta): - PRD & billing model approved - runtime token-bucket impl + metrics - canary infra + revert playbook - dashboards + customer opt-in flow - docs + engineering runbook.

thomas (Data): OKRs alignment: ties to infra-cost-efficiency OKR (reduce peak tail spend by 12%) and reliability OKR (p95 latency < target during bursts).

ajay (Eng): action items: @ajay prototype token bucket + preempt hook (owner), @lucy setup canary harness and alerts, @thomas run sizing model for credits, @maria coordinate finance/legal.

maria (PM): timeline suggestion: prototype in 2 sprints, canary mid-quarter, beta opt-in by quarter end. strong preference to keep scope minimal for first beta (no auto-upgrade lane). :calendar:

lucy (SRE): noted. one more: include a debug endpoint returning `tenant_burst_status` to help support troubleshoot.

maria (PM): thanks all. I'll update the PRD with these decisions and ping for signoffs. :thumbsup:
